title: What JAN is using in this conversation
description: What is available to JAN, what was chosen for a request, and what was actually sent. Changes here affect future messages, not a reply already being written.

state.pending-next-message: Will be sent with your next message

location.local: Runs on this device or your network. Messages do not leave it.
location.remote: Remote provider: your messages and included files are sent to it.
location.checking: Still checking where this provider runs.
location.unknown: Where this provider runs could not be determined.

reason.assistantInstructions: The assistant's instructions are sent as the system prompt.
reason.pendingInline: Its text will be placed into your next message.
reason.pendingEmbeddings: It will be indexed; JAN reads the relevant parts only when it searches.
reason.inlineSent: Its text was placed into the message that attached it.
reason.retrievalNotRecorded: Indexed for search. Which parts JAN read is not recorded; only files it searched could have been used.
reason.temporaryChat: Temporary chats neither read nor save memory.
reason.memoryNotSentYet: No message has been sent from this window yet, so no memory selection is known. Saved memories are not all sent: JAN picks the ones that apply.
reason.memoryInjected: Chosen and sent with the last message.
reason.memoryDetailsUnavailable: Sent with the last message; its details could not be loaded.
reason.memoryConflicts: Memories that contradict each other are withheld until you resolve them.
reason.memoryDropped: Applicable memories that did not fit in the budget were left out.
reason.modelWithoutTools: The selected model does not support tools, so none are offered.
reason.toolFromServer: Offered to the model from this connection. JAN asks before using tools that need permission.
reason.toolBuiltIn: A built-in tool offered to the model.
reason.toolsTurnedOff: Tools you turned off are not offered in any conversation.
reason.chatPayloadNotRecorded: Normal conversations do not keep a copy of the exact request. Cowork sessions record a sanitized copy you can inspect.

label.temporary: Memory is off in temporary chats
label.notSentYet: Nothing sent from this window yet

empty.noInstructions: No assistant instructions. Normal conversations do not read project instruction files such as JAN.md; Cowork does.
empty.noAttachments: No files are attached to this conversation.
empty.indexUnavailable: Indexed files could not be listed.
empty.noMemory: No saved memory was sent with the last message.

memoryScopeNote: Editing or forgetting a memory affects future messages only.
